verdict.rationale: Independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) confirm strong sustained multi-core productivity performance and note 'energy efficient' characteristics with full overclocking headroom and improved thermal design (inverted CCD stacking), but none provide explicit long-render sustained power-per-watt curves, thermal throttling data over extended export workloads, or documented power envelope charts for creator export tasks specifically. missing for 10: documented TDP/PPT power envelope tables, independent sustained-load (30min+) render/export benchmarks showing no throttling, and creator-specific power-efficiency measurements (perf/watt charts).
